lines.en: Cracks in the rocks, earth trembles.
Swings giant claws, ready to strike.

lines.zh: 一千年了，我的关节还在响。
lines.en: A thousand years, and my joints still creak.

lines.zh: 在洞穴入口休憩，守护地盘。
lines.en: Resting at cave entrance, guarding territory.

lines.zh: 享受温暖阳光，放松自己。

lines.en: I count the veins of black gold ore.
My claws rasp along the rock wall.

lines.zh: 黑金之心在我胸腔里跳。
lines.en: The black gold heart beats in my chest.

lines.zh: 我在洞口磨着两只巨爪。
lines.en: I grind my two great claws at the cave mouth.

lines.zh: 让岩浆的光照着我的背。
lines.en: I let the lava light fall on my back.

lines.zh: 低吼一声，抖落肩上碎石。
lines.en: I growl once and shake the rubble off my shoulders.
Fixing you in sight, ready to attack.
Watching you, wanting to eat you.

lines.zh: 追踪你的动作，随时攻击。
lines.en: Tracking your movements, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 凝视你的身影，伺机而动。
锁定目标，准备发动攻击。
盯紧你不放，不容你逃脱。
lines.en: Staring firmly, not letting you escape.
Which stone did you just crush underfoot?

lines.zh: 你的影子挡了我的矿脉。
lines.en: Your shadow is blocking my ore vein.

lines.zh: 你看起来像是我的猎物。

lines.en: You pose a threat to me.

lines.zh: 我用岩石将你砸成粉碎。

lines.en: The Augite heart beats in my chest.

lines.zh: 黑金之心跳一下，我就找一圈。
lines.en: Each beat of my black-gold heart, I search again.

lines.zh: 黑金里，没有一个配得上我。
lines.en: In black gold, none of them is worth me.

lines.zh: 黑金世界里，我等一个同类。
lines.en: In the black gold world, I wait for one of my kind.

lines.zh: 岩晶胸甲闪烁，迪索斯现身。
黑金之心跳动，迪索斯苏醒。
迪索斯的吼声震耳欲聋。
黑金之心闪耀，迪索斯怒视。
它的巨石砸落，你必须闪避。
lines.en: Its giant rocks fall, you must dodge.

lines.zh: 迪索斯瞄准你，准备攻击。
lines.en: Densos targets you, prepares to attack.

lines.zh: 迪索斯盯着你，威胁意味浓厚。
你成为了迪索斯的目标。
迪索斯的注意力集中到你身上。
迪索斯的视线锁定在你身上。
迪索斯对你的位置了如指掌。
碎石滚到你脚边，我记下了。
lines.en: Gravel rolled to your feet. I noted it.

lines.zh: 你的脚步震得岩层发响。
lines.en: Your steps make the rock layers ring.
I followed the ore vein and found you.
You smell like prey to me.
The rock layers tell me where you went.
I have sealed off the cave mouth.

lines.zh: 你已经被岩壁围起来了。
lines.en: The rock walls have already closed around you.

lines.zh: 迪索斯的猎物，从不落空。
迪索斯的攻击路线已规划。
迪索斯的攻击瞄准要害。
lines.en: Densos' attack targets the vital spot.

lines.zh: 迪索斯的视线锁定你的弱点。
lines.en: Densos' gaze locks on your weak spot.

lines.zh: 迪索斯的攻击将直击要害。
lines.en: Densos' attack will hit the vital spot.

lines.zh: 迪索斯的攻击即将展开。
lines.en: Densos' attack is about to begin.

lines.zh: 迪索斯的策略针对你的弱点。
lines.en: Densos' strategy targets your weak points.

lines.zh: 巨爪举起来，瞄准你的头。
lines.en: My great claw lifts, aimed at your head.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫过，准备砸下。
lines.en: My tail sweeps past, ready to slam down.

lines.zh: 矿脉的裂缝，正好圈住你。
lines.en: The ore vein's cracks have ringed you in.
A boulder tightens in my grip.

lines.zh: 我的巨爪在岩壁上刮出白痕。
lines.en: My huge claws scrape white marks on the rock wall.
The walls close in. You have no way out.
Let me smash your shield first.

lines.zh: 黑金之光照着你的破绽。
lines.en: Black gold light shows me your gap.

lines.zh: 我数着你的心跳，准备动手。
lines.en: I count your heartbeat and get ready.

lines.zh: 这一击，会连地带你一起碎。
lines.en: This blow will shatter the ground and you.

lines.zh: 爪子落地，就是你倒下之时。
lines.en: When my claw lands, you fall.
Charge, get out of the way!

lines.zh: 我抬爪，把岩层一起掀起来。
lines.en: I raise my claw, tearing up the rock layer.
My great claw falls and the rock splits!
I press you down into the rock!
My tail sweeps past and bones crack!
The black gold heart lends me strength!

lines.zh: 黑暗中现身，我是迪索斯！
lines.en: I am Densos, from the darkness.
The black gold land, waiting for prey.

lines.zh: 祭坛的水晶碎了一地，我醒了。
lines.en: The altar crystal shatters; I wake.
I am the guardian, face me!

lines.zh: 我从黑金矿脉里直起腰。
lines.en: I straighten up out of the black-gold vein.
You are my dinner, savor it!

lines.zh: 黑金岩层裂开，我出来了。
lines.en: The black gold strata split, and I emerge.
Are you the one who shattered the crystal?

lines.zh: 岩晶的碎屑还落在我肩上。
lines.en: Crystal shards still fall from my shoulders.

lines.zh: 黑金世界的守护者在此。
lines.en: The guardian of the black gold world is here.
I climb up from deep in the ore vein.
Who calls me before the altar?

lines.zh: 岩层为我让开了一条路。
lines.en: The rock layers opened a path for me.

lines.zh: 我抖落身上千斤的石头。
lines.en: I shake a thousand pounds of stone off my back.

lines.zh: 黑金之心重新开始跳动。
lines.en: The black gold heart begins to beat again.

lines.zh: 地底的裂缝里，我抬头了。
lines.en: In the fissure below, I raise my head.

lines.zh: 火焰舔过我的鳞片，好烫！
lines.en: Flames lick my scales. Too hot!

lines.zh: 我从高处砸下来，骨头闷响。
lines.en: I crash down from above, bones thudding.
Water covers my claws. I hate it.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，鳞片嗡嗡响。
lines.en: The blast flips me over, my scales ringing.

lines.zh: 箭钉在我的鳞片上，烦人。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my scales. Annoying.

lines.zh: 电击穿透鳞片，麻到骨头！
lines.en: Lightning pierces my scales, numbing my bones!
The void tears at my shell!
